answer: Sybil attackers must acquire and lock one bond per fake identity, and coordinated farms get detected when stakes trace to a single harbor wallet. Participants stake a scarce on-chain asset, a carved marble credential, to register; each identity must lock a bond that is slashed if its behavior duplicates another. Honest agents stake once and earn fees, while forgers burn capital on frozen tundra of idle bonds, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
